name: pokemon-cards-scanner-app
description: PWA para escanear cartas Pokemon, ver su valor de mercado y gestionar colecciones

scripts.setup: pnpm run install:all && pnpm run infra:up && pnpm run db:migrate && node scripts/setup-done.mjs
scripts.stop: for p in ${API_PORT:-3001} ${WEB_PORT:-3000}; do ids=$(lsof -ti:$p 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$ids" ] && kill $ids 2>/dev/null; done; echo 'puertos liberados'
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --dir backend exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --dir backend exec prisma generate
scripts.db:push: pnpm --dir backend exec prisma db push && pnpm --dir backend exec prisma generate
scripts.cache:clear: docker exec pokemon-scanner-redis redis-cli FLUSHDB && echo 'caché vaciada'
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run lint
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist backend/dist-seed frontend/.next && echo 'builds borrados'
